DESCRIPTION: Returns the scheduled timetable arrival at destination directly from the reconstructed journey.
ASSUMPTIONS: Timetable is the planned route; no real-time state considered
LIMITATIONS: Ignores all current conditions; scheduled arrival is not actual arrival

DESCRIPTION: Adds a live current delay to the scheduled arrival to estimate a shifted ETA.
ASSUMPTIONS: Current delay persists unchanged to destination; delay from real-time source only
LIMITATIONS: Assumes constant delay propagation; no segment-level recovery modelled; DA323 must NOT be used as delay source

DESCRIPTION: A trained model estimating ETA from historical journeys, segment delays, and live state.
ASSUMPTIONS: Requires verified actual arrival timestamps and time-aligned train state features
LIMITATIONS: Cannot be implemented until large-scale historical actual arrival data is collected
